required_observation: Promise calculation must separate processing, transit, and final-mile components.
proposal: Typed components and explicit final endpoint; zero distinct from missing.

required_observation: Promise policy must support Express, Same Day, Next Day, Standard, Relaxed, and merchant-defined service levels.
proposal: Service code/label distinct; literal local-day completion and truthful alternatives.

required_observation: Promise calculation must use business calendars and closure dates.
proposal: Versioned calendars/closures/IANA zones; finite lookahead and explicit DST.

required_observation: Promise calculation must enforce service cutoffs.
proposal: Cutoff equality misses service window; upper completion feasibility is separate.

required_observation: Promise calculation must consider capacity where configured.
proposal: Required native revisioned capacity observation; unknown/stale refuse; reservation separate.

required_observation: Sequential and parallel legs must aggregate promises correctly.
proposal: Bounded acyclic temporal plan; series carry and parallel max join.

required_observation: Promise results must identify the governing policy version.
proposal: Exact policy/calendar/source/runtime receipts; immutable versions and original replay.

required_observation: Customer-facing ETA must be explainable and localized.
proposal: Localized whitelist and explanations; absolute/relative anchor/timezone explicit.

required_observation: Promise failure must not silently display an invented date.
proposal: Typed unavailable/ineligible; no null-to-zero, invented dates or legacy payment fallback.

required_observation: Accepted promise facts must be frozen into the order snapshot.
proposal: Reader-first versioned mandatory accepted packet and original/current ETA split.
